_doc: Every world and level in Island Blast. A level with a 'kind' is playable; one without is
shown on the map as coming soon. To add a level of an existing kind, give it a 'kind' and
a 'dir' (asset folder with its art and settings). Kinds: 'color-shift' (Level 5),
'storm-dodge' (Level 6), 'treasure-slice' (Mystic Harvest). 'node' is where its button sits on the
world map (map-art px). 'config' (optional) overrides keys of the level's own settings file.
'planned' is a level's name in the master spec while it is not built yet: it is not shown
anywhere (the map marks the level 'Coming Soon'); give the level a 'name', 'kind' and 'dir'
when it is built. (Mystic Harvest, the treasure-slicing level, is built but is not Jungle
Zip, so it is not on the map: its kind 'treasure-slice' and folder 'level4' are kept.)
'gate' is the way on to the next world, at the end of the map's path: finishing the world's
last level completes the world and unlocks it.
